card.name: The digit 7 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 7, or the decimal point right after a leading 7, inside percentages, counts and dose figures in clinical-trial or dosing text.

modes.label: Decimal point after 7
modes.description: The period in a number like 7.4 or 47.8 that follows a 7.
modes.example: withholding of TECENTRIQ in 7<<.>>4% of patients

modes.label: Digit 7 itself
modes.description: The digit 7 inside a percentage or fraction of patients.
modes.example: Rash resolved in <<7>>7% of the 17 patients

card.plain: It lights up on the number 7 or the decimal point after it in trial percentages and dose amounts.
